cards.name: ChomChom Roller (Original)
cards.badge: Good · under $30 · our top pick for pet hair
cards.price: Under $30 most days · $23.99 at Walmart (September 2026) · 20–30% off on deal days; 40% off is a rare low
cards.chip: No refills · no batteries · no cord
cards.buy_if: you have a couch, a car seat or a duvet and a pet that sheds; it is the cheapest thing on this page that changes daily life.
cards.skip_if: you want it for carpet pile or loose blankets — it needs a taut, firm surface (a vacuum or an Uproot Cleaner Pro does carpet).
cards.owners: Testers at Wirecutter, CNN Underscored and Reader's Digest rate it for upholstery; Reader's Digest cleared a cushion in about 30 seconds. Owners praise that there is nothing to refill. Complaints: a week to learn the stroke, and the button pops open under your thumb.
cards.video_title: Bull or No Bull? ABC15 tests the ChomChom Roller
cards.video_why: A local TV consumer team tests the roller on camera and rates it “no bull,” with the fair footnote that results vary by fabric. Watch the stroke: short, quick, back and forth. Long rolls do nothing, which is the whole learning curve in one shot.

cards.name: Neakasa P1 Pro Grooming Vacuum Kit
cards.badge: Better · under $100 on sale · our top grooming vacuum
cards.price: Under $100 on sale in 2026 · about a third off list is a good buy · close to half off is the floor
cards.buy_if: your dog or cat sheds enough that you brush weekly and the fur still ends up everywhere; it turns the brush into a vacuum.
cards.skip_if: you have a big double-coated dog and want one-pass grooming (the 1-liter cup fills fast — the P2 Pro's 2-liter cup is the fix), or you want a full shave-down tool.
cards.owners: Dogster scores it 4.9/5; Neakasa's own store shows 4.8/5 from 770 reviews (September 2026). Owners praise that fur goes straight into the bin and that vacuum-averse dogs accept it after a few short sessions. Complaints: emptying the cup mid-groom, and the clipper is for trims, not shaves.
cards.video_title: Neabot Neakasa P1 Pro grooming kit and vacuum review: best pet grooming vacuum?
cards.video_why: A full-length review of the P1 Pro kit built around the question we asked: is this the best pet grooming vacuum? Watch it for the attachments and the noise before you buy.

cards.name: Whisker Litter-Robot 4
cards.badge: Best · $699 direct · our top robot litter box
cards.price: $699 direct at litter-robot.com all of 2026 · $799 with a 3-year warranty · Costco bundle $699.99 (July 2026) · reconditioned $599 direct
cards.chip: Up to 4 cats · app · no subscription
cards.buy_if: you have one to four cats, hate scooping, or travel — the sealed drawer and the app are what owners keep praising in Whisker's 7,000-plus verified reviews.
cards.skip_if: you have a kitten under 3 lb (semi-automatic mode until then), a cat that hates enclosed boxes (see the open-top Neakasa M1), or you can wait for Black Friday bundles.
cards.owners: 4.4/5 across 7,000-plus verified reviews on Whisker's own site (September 2026); Catster 4.6, Hepper 4.85. Praise: odor control, hands-off, quiet. Complaints: the price, occasional false 'drawer full' readings (wipe the sensors), OdorTrap refills add up.
cards.video_title: Litter-Robot 4: still the best after three years? (One Man Five Cats)
cards.video_channel: One Man Five Cats · long-term review
cards.video_why: Three years and five cats after buying it, a cat-tech channel asks whether the Litter-Robot 4 is still the one to buy — the long-term view most reviews can’t give, and the question to settle before spending $699.
